name: Trigonometry
description: Start from right-angled triangles and unroll the unit circle into waves.

lessonNames.l2-ratios-that-stay: Ratios that depend only on the angle
lessonNames.l8-unrolling: Unrolling the circle into a wave

lessonObjectives.l1-squares-on-sides: Use Pythagoras’ theorem to find a missing side, and see why it holds.
lessonObjectives.l2-ratios-that-stay: Define sine, cosine and tangent from similar right-angled triangles.
lessonObjectives.l3-sides-and-angles: Find missing sides and angles in right-angled triangles.
lessonObjectives.l4-exact-values: Derive exact values at 30, 45 and 60 degrees from two special triangles.
lessonObjectives.l5-no-right-angle: Use the sine and cosine rules, and choose the right one.
lessonObjectives.l6-beyond-90: Extend sine and cosine to any angle with the unit circle.
lessonObjectives.l7-arc-length: Convert between degrees and radians and say why radians are natural.
lessonObjectives.l8-unrolling: Draw the graphs of sine and cosine from a point moving round the circle.
lessonObjectives.l9-stretching-a-wave: Read amplitude, period and phase from a trigonometric graph.
lessonObjectives.l10-identity-from-circle: Derive $\sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$ from the unit circle and use it.
lessonObjectives.l11-every-angle: Solve a trigonometric equation and find every solution in an interval.
lessonObjectives.l12-adding-angles: Use the compound angle formulae, and derive the double angle formulae from them.
lessonObjectives.l13-modelling-a-cycle: Fit a sine curve to a repeating pattern in data.
